description: Schemas bundled with fair-bioheaders, by FHR-Specification release (docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md in FHR-Specification). 'current' are the copies of FHR-Specification main that raw-main URLs select, and 'release' names the release they belong to (null when main is ahead of every release). Each release entry points at a frozen copy of that release's schema. 'drafts' are unaccepted development contracts from the type repositories; they are never selected unless draft support is explicitly enabled, carry no release tag and no w3id alias, and are not part of the SCHEMA-VERSIONS rules V1-V6 (see docs/FHT-SELECTION-DESIGN.md).

FHT.source: FHT-Specification (development repository; no released contract, no w3id alias, not in schemas/versions.json)

suite.description: The conformance suite the FHT draft lane is scored against, pinned apart from the contract above: tests/fht_conformance_test.py reads <FHT_SPECIFICATION>/conformance/manifest.json from whatever checkout and revision the operator points at, so this block names the revision and bytes a recorded pass was measured on, and every fixture it scores is compared with `git show <revision>:conformance/<path>`. The contract and the suite move independently: `fht.json` is byte-identical at 226f923, 24d3b03 and 7503b26, while the manifest has gone 65 vectors at 226f923 (d9025104), 66 at 24d3b03 (9b071794) and 68 at 7503b26 (ab72fc98, the two gzip stream cases of FHT-Specification#46). The vector count is an additional assertion, never a substitute for the digest: FHGM's manifest moved from 31f14f02 to 5620f00c between its #15 and #17 with the same 31 vectors and the same expected outcomes.
